name: transition-blur-crossfade
title: Blur Crossfade
description: Hai cảnh cùng nhoè lên đỉnh ở giữa rồi rõ lại, cảnh mới hiện dần đè lên, như tiêu điểm vừa chuyển.

moworks.author: takayu

options.blur: px at the peak, half-way (14; the site's demo 10, here ×4 for the film)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-blur, written here): Both scenes blur 0 -> 14 px -> 0 as a half-sine over 600 ms (demo peak 10 px); incoming opacity 0 -> 1 easeInOutSine over the same 600 ms, so the swap reads at 300 ms when the blur peaks. Params: duration (0.6 s) · blur: đỉnh nhoè (14 px) · ease (sine.inOut).
